_README.description: Predicted (ML-derived, NOT DFT) elastic/mechanical properties for all 2737 possible M2AX MAX-phase formulas built from the 17 M / 23 A / 7 X elements seen in the training set.
_README.model: XGBoost (composition-based features incl. VEC), see accompanying notebook
_README.warning: Mechanical_Stability was not modeled (too few unstable training examples: 5 vs 548). Predictions for elements/combinations far outside the training distribution should be treated with caution.
